title: Edits of the input values of a scenario's runs
description: Inputs are named entity.field. `set` edits every run, `options` the runs that name an option, and `runs` one run. The narrower edit wins: one run, then one option, then every run; every edit wins over the value that an option gives and over the default. A bool input takes true or false, a named input one of its names, and a number is in the unit of the input's type. A value can also be a distribution, written as in a scenario file with its units, such as "pert(48 h, 96 h, 200 h)"; its arguments are numbers. Fixed fields cannot be edited.
